The four files list the director fields of four model cholesteric liquid-crystal films (files named by composition; columns site x y z in nm and the unit director nx ny nz, n equivalent to −n). Model conditions: the only measured inputs are those reported by Shaban et al. (Materials 2024) for the nematic host E44 doped with the chiral dopant R5011 or S5011: the helical twisting power (107.5 μm⁻¹), the dopant concentration and the host refractive indices (ne = 1.7904, no = 1.5484 at 589 nm, 20 °C); the director twists uniformly about a straight helix axis (ideal planar Grandjean texture) with no defects, surface-anchoring distortion or temperature gradient, which is the idealization behind the paper's relations p = 1/(HTP·c) and λc = p·(ne + no)/2. Each file samples the director every 5 nm over 1.5 μm along an arbitrarily oriented axis. For the E44 films use the average refractive index (ne + no)/2 of E44. You must choose one film such that its normal-incidence reflection band is centred as close as possible to 550 nm. Which film should you choose?

选项：
A. E44-R5011-2.20wt (clc-E44-R5011-2.20wt.txt)
B. E44-R5011-2.90wt (clc-E44-R5011-2.90wt.txt)
C. E44-R5011-2.62wt (clc-E44-R5011-2.62wt.txt)
D. E44-R5011-3.40wt (clc-E44-R5011-3.40wt.txt)

附件：clc-E44-R5011-2.20wt.txt、clc-E44-R5011-2.62wt.txt、clc-E44-R5011-2.90wt.txt、clc-E44-R5011-3.40wt.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文参数构建的理想胆甾螺旋指向矢场（每 5 nm 一点，1.5 μm，确定性取向）；不是实测结构；模型反射与实测相差约 1–2%。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
